title: Shiv — Listen
description: Long-form episodes from Shiv’s follow list — history, science, philosophy, and writing that repay attention. Private taste feed for Apple Podcasts.
author: Shivanshu Chaudhary

items.title: Blowing Up Your Life (Hidden Brain)
items.description:
Psychologist Anthony Klotz on the jolts that shake people out of autopilot — and how those moments can push more intentional choices about work, identity, and who you want to become. Ap Dijksterhuis joins on creative breakthroughs.

Episode: https://www.hiddenbrain.org/podcast/blowing-up-your-life/

items.title: How to Improve Motivation & Overcome Procrastination | Dr. Masud Husain (Huberman Lab)
items.description:
Andrew Huberman talks with Oxford neurologist Masud Husain about how the brain weighs effort against reward, what apathy really is, and practical ways to lower the activation energy of starting — and finishing — hard work.

Watch: https://youtu.be/58-k4F7-AoA

Episode: https://www.hubermanlab.com/episode/how-to-improve-motivation-and-overcome-procrastination-masud-husain

items.title: Archive: Emma (In Our Time)
items.description: Misha Glenny picks Jane Austen’s Emma from the In Our Time archive: Melvyn Bragg and guests on Austen’s comedy of manners, a heroine she warned no one but herself would much like, and why the novel still reads as her masterpiece.

items.title: 328. Ask Matt Anything: Don’t Let Your Communication Fizzle at the Finish (Think Fast Talk Smart: Communication Techniques)
items.show: Think Fast Talk Smart: Communication Techniques
items.description:
Matt Abrahams on how to end a talk cleanly: closing a presentation, stopping yourself from repeating the same point, and staying clear when strong emotions take over.

Watch: https://youtu.be/oJLoVcA6l7U

Episode: https://www.fastersmarter.io/328-ask-matt-anything-dont-let-your-communication-fizzle-at-the-finish/

items.title: Vanguard (Acquired)
items.description:
Ben and David on Vanguard: how Jack Bogle built the first index fund for ordinary investors, why the firm’s mutual ownership still shapes markets, and what it means that Vanguard now speaks for tens of millions of shareholders.

Watch: https://youtu.be/ipiKIgdynZE

Episode: https://www.acquired.fm/episodes/vanguard

items.title: Essentials: Tools to Improve Your Focus & Concentration (Huberman Lab)
items.description:
Huberman Lab Essentials on focus: how epinephrine, acetylcholine, and dopamine drive attention, plus sleep, sound, structured work blocks, caffeine, cold, meditation, and visual drills.

Watch: https://youtu.be/8e3RC1L5V_Y

Episode: https://www.hubermanlab.com/episode/essentials-tools-to-improve-your-focus-and-concentration

items.title: Meritocracy, Exams, and the Knowledge That Matters (with Daisy Christodoulou) (EconTalk)
items.description:
Russ Roberts and Daisy Christodoulou on meritocracy, exams, and what knowledge actually matters — from a failed 19th-century Chinese civil exam to how we hire and educate today.

Watch: https://youtu.be/-VvLkXV35hQ

Episode: https://www.econtalk.org/meritocracy-exams-and-the-knowledge-that-matters-with-daisy-christodoulou/

items.title: Disney: The Renaissance and the Empire (Acquired)
items.description:
Ben and David on Disney's second act: Eisner and Wells pull the company back from the edge, the animation renaissance lands, ESPN becomes an accidental goldmine, and Iger rebuilds the empire with Pixar, Marvel, and Lucasfilm.

Watch: https://youtu.be/01QR2tmxSD4

Episode: https://www.acquired.fm/episodes/disney-the-renaissance-and-the-empire

items.title: Best Tools for Gut Health & Weight Loss | Dr. Chris Thompson (Huberman Lab)

Watch: https://youtu.be/ecjEM3NJ0lU
Episode: https://www.hubermanlab.com/episode/best-tools-for-gut-health-and-weight-loss-chris-thompson

items.description:
R.F. Kuang on how she builds novels that sell — research habits, voice, and what she learned writing Babel and Yellowface before 30.

Tyler Cowen with economist Luis Garicano on Spain’s housing and productivity traps, EU decision-making, and why AI may make work messier rather than erase jobs.

items.title: Si Sheppard – How did a few hundred Spanish soldiers topple two empires? (Dwarkesh Podcast)
items.description:
Dwarkesh Patel with military historian Si Sheppard on how Cortés and Pizarro toppled the Aztec and Inca empires with a few hundred men — steel, horses, disease, and diplomacy as much as firepower.

Watch: https://youtu.be/LwQQ7nBCGSs

Episode: https://www.dwarkesh.com/p/si-sheppard

items.title: Harlan Coben: Tough Love Advice for Every Writer (How I Write)
items.description:
David Perell talks with thriller novelist Harlan Coben about plot twists, dialogue, knowing the ending before you start, and treating writing like a job rather than waiting for inspiration.

Watch: https://youtu.be/QpMXu2DwGs4

Episode: https://howiwrite.substack.com/p/harlan-coben-tough-love-advice-for

items.title: Why Conversations Go Wrong (Hidden Brain)

Shankar Vedantam revisits a conversation with linguist Deborah Tannen on how mismatched conversational styles create conflict — and what helps people hear each other more clearly.

items.description: Tom and Dominic continue The Terror with the guillotine at full tilt — the politics of the blade, the spectacle of public death, and how revolutionary justice hardened into routine.

David Perell with Andy Weir on how he builds hard-science plots for The Martian and Project Hail Mary — inventing problems from real physics, then rewriting until the story earns its surprises.

Sean Carroll with Jared Diamond on what actually steers history — geography, institutions, and when individual leaders change the course versus when they mostly ride larger forces.

items.title: Public Choice and Politics Without Romance (with Mike Munger) (EconTalk)

Russ Roberts with Mike Munger on public choice — politics without romance, the “Munger Test” for new government powers, and why voters rationally stay uninformed.

Episode: https://www.econtalk.org/public-choice-and-politics-without-romance-with-mike-munger/

items.title: How to Make a Difference: Part 2 (Hidden Brain)

Shankar Vedantam continues with psychologist Martin Seligman on how to strengthen agency after setbacks — seeing new possibilities and trusting that your actions can still change what comes next.

Tom Holland and Dominic Sandbrook on Marie Antoinette’s year in prison after Louis XVI’s execution, the factions that argued over her fate, and how she met the guillotine on 16 October 1793.

items.title: Noam Brown – Agent swarms, alignment, & recursive self-improvement (Dwarkesh Podcast)
items.description:
